caption: Terrace of Infinity, Ravello
composition: Villa Cimbrone cliff terrace above the Amalfi Coast · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is on the Terrace of Infinity itself, looking along the stone walkway toward the open sea. The arched loggia and its small bell tower stand at the left, a tall cypress rises at the center of the frame, and the balustraded terrace path runs rightward above the Amalfi Coast, with the blue sea filling the right half of the picture. The modelled 23 September 2026, 08:22 morning is bright and clear, the sun already high enough to throw crisp shadows across the paving.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Terrace of Infinity in Ravello under clear morning light
